title: A Network-Based Examination of the Longitudinal Association Between Psychopathy and Offending Versatility
network_types: between-subjects network, temporal network, contemporaneous network
limitations: - Reliance on self-report measures; - Limited number of measurement waves; - Potential for mono-operation bias; - Data were not collected via ESM/EMA methods.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. The authors mention using the 'graphicalVAR' package for R and 'qgraph' for visualization, but do not specify if the code is publicly available. The data were collected from the Pathways to Desistance Study, which is publicly available, but the specific data used in this analysis may not be publicly available without access to the original dataset.
